items.effect: approximated: font names are kept as written, but text in these fonts will show in a substitute unless the host provides them
items.label: font(s) the editor may not have

items.effect: approximated: flattened, the placeholder keeps the position and size it inherits as its own
items.label: placeholder(s) that take their position from the layout (flattened on import)

items.effect: lost: not imported (the PPTX reader does not read this yet)
items.label: slide master(s) in a deck with more than one

items.effect: kept: the language tag is stored on the run; it does not drive spell checking
items.label: run(s) tagged with a language other than en-US

items.effect: approximated: colours are resolved through the map into theme colours; the map itself is not kept
items.label: colour map(s) that are not the default

items.effect: lost: not imported (the PPTX reader does not read this yet)
items.label: theme effect scheme(s) with shadows, glow or reflection

items.effect: approximated: font names are kept as written and theme font references are resolved to them
items.label: theme font scheme(s) other than Office default
